meta.title: Power Converter — Convert Watt and More
meta.description: Free power converter for 7+ units including Watt, Kilowatt, Megawatt. Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Watts, horsepower, kilowatts. Fast, accurate conversions with engineering-grade precision for everyday and professional use. Convert between 7 power units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for power in this tool is **W**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most power conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.
content.conversion_table:

| --- | --- |
| Watt | W |

| BTU/hour | BTU/h |
| Foot-pound/second | ft·lb/s |
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
content.faq:
**Q:** How accurate is this power converter?
**A:** It uses 7 canonical unit definitions and 12-digit precision constants.

**Q:** Is it free?
**A:** Yes — completely free, no signup, no limits.

**Q:** Which units are supported?
**A:** Watt (W), Kilowatt (kW), Megawatt (MW), Horsepower (mech) (hp), Horsepower (metric) (hp (M)), BTU/hour (BTU/h), Foot-pound/second (ft·lb/s).
